label: Every actual distinct esse is caused by its quiddity (NATURE_SOURCE_2) or by another
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, the weakest exhaustiveness in De ente's vocabulary: for every x that actually exists with esse distinct from its essence, either x's own quiddity efficiently causes x's esse (NATURE_SOURCE_2) or some c other than x causes x's esse (CausesIn c x esse, the tenseless cause of being). Restricted to esse and to distinct-esse beings. With the self-causation reading it entails the vocabulary-free premise that every actual distinct esse has some cause of being. Brute esse, a non-efficient intrinsic account, and a non-causal global or structural explanation all reject it. Derived from the literal De ente disjunction only through the efficiency bridge.
